trailer_style.description: Style of attribution trailer to add to commits

generated_with.description: Add Generated with Crush line to commit messages and issues and PRs

max_depth.description: Maximum depth for the ls tool

max_items.description: Maximum number of items to return for the ls tool

models.description: Model configurations for different model types

hooks.description: User-defined shell commands that fire on hook events (e.g. PreToolUse)

matcher.description: Regex pattern tested against the tool name. Empty means match all tools.

command.description: Shell command to execute when the hook fires

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the hook command

disabled.description: Whether this LSP server is disabled

command.description: Command to execute for the LSP server

args.description: Arguments to pass to the LSP server command

env.description: Environment variables to set to the LSP server command

filetypes.description: File types this LSP server handles

root_markers.description: Files or directories that indicate the project root

init_options.description: Initialization options passed to the LSP server during initialize request

options.description: LSP server-specific settings passed during initialization

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for LSP server initialization

command.description: Command to execute for stdio MCP servers

env.description: Environment variables to set for the MCP server

args.description: Arguments to pass to the MCP server command

url.description: URL for HTTP or SSE MCP servers

disabled.description: Whether this MCP server is disabled

disabled_tools.description: List of tools from this MCP server to disable

enabled_tools.description: Allow list of tools from this MCP server

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for MCP server connections

headers.description: HTTP headers for HTTP/SSE MCP servers

window.description: Number of most recent steps inspected when looking for a tool-call spiral. Defaults to 7.

repeat_threshold.description: Trip the nudge once any single tool is called at least this many times within the window. Defaults to 5.

max_injections.description: Maximum number of mid-run nudges injected per run. Defaults to 2.

context_paths.description: Paths to files containing context information for the AI

skills_paths.description: Paths to directories containing Agent Skills (folders with SKILL.md files)

debug_lsp.description: Enable debug logging for LSP servers

data_directory.description: Directory for storing application data. Relative paths are resolved against the working directory; absolute paths are used as-is.

disabled_tools.description: List of built-in tools to disable and hide from the agent

task_tools.description: Tools the spawned Task (sub-)agent may call. Built-in tool names plus the special token 'mcp' (grants all MCP tools). Defaults to the read-only set (glob/grep/ls/sourcegraph/view) with no MCP when unset. Disabled tools are still excluded.

disable_default_providers.description: Ignore all default/embedded providers. When enabled, providers must be fully specified in the config file with base_url, models, and api_key - no merging with defaults occurs

disable_update_check.description: Disable the startup check for new Crush versions

initialize_as.description: Name of the context file to create/update during project initialization

auto_lsp.description: Automatically setup LSPs based on root markers

progress.description: Show indeterminate progress updates during long operations

disable_notifications.description: Deprecated: Use notification_style instead. Disable desktop notifications

notification_style.description: Notification style to use. Options: auto (default)

disabled_skills.description: List of skill names to disable and hide from the agent

enable_memory.description: Store large tool results in memory for later retrieval via memory_list and memory_scroll. Enabled by default.

memory_hard_limit_bytes.description: Byte length above which tool results are stored in memory (default 8192)

memory_overspill.description: Fraction of the hard limit tolerated inline before storing — e.g. 0.20 means up to hard_limit*1.20 is kept inline (default 0.20)

memory_preview_lines.description: Lines shown in the inline reference summary returned to the model (default 10)

memory_refuse_tools.description: Tool names that reject oversized results instead of storing them. The model is told to re-call with narrower parameters (e.g. view with offset/limit).

enable_task_self_assessment.description: After a run that ends with incomplete todos, inject a follow-up prompt asking the model to verify and close out finished tasks and complete any that are genuinely unfinished.

task_self_assessment.description: Tuning for the task self-assessment reminders (requires enable_task_self_assessment). Controls how many reminders to send and when to stop.

subagent_enable_task_self_assessment.description: Override enable_task_self_assessment for the spawned Task sub-agent only. When unset, the sub-agent inherits the global value.

subagent_task_self_assessment.description: Override the task self-assessment reminder tuning for the spawned Task sub-agent only. When unset, the sub-agent inherits the global tuning.

enable_midrun_self_assessment.description: During a run, detect a tool-call spiral (e.g. the same search repeated many times) and inject a one-shot nudge with the run's tool-usage stats asking the model to scope tighter or abandon the approach.

midrun_self_assessment.description: Tuning for the mid-run self-assessment nudge (requires enable_midrun_self_assessment). Controls the detection window, repeat threshold, and how many nudges may be injected per run.

subagent_enable_midrun_self_assessment.description: Override enable_midrun_self_assessment for the spawned Task sub-agent only. When unset, the sub-agent inherits the global value.

subagent_midrun_self_assessment.description: Override the mid-run self-assessment tuning for the spawned Task sub-agent only. Merges field-by-field over the global tuning: set only the fields you want to change, the rest are inherited.

compact_tools.description: Use shorter tool descriptions to reduce prompt token usage. Useful for local/small-context models.

compact_prompt.description: Use a shorter system prompt to reduce token usage. Recommended for local/small-context models.

summarize_prompt.description: Async: use the small model to compress the system prompt at session start. First turn uses the base prompt; later turns use the summarized version.

stream_subagent_output.description: In non-interactive mode (crush run), stream the live output of spawned sub-agents (the agent tool) to stdout in addition to the top-level agent's output. Sub-agents run in child sessions whose output is otherwise surfaced only as a tool result.

allowed_tools.description: List of tools that don't require permission prompts

base_url.description: Base URL for the provider's API

type.description: Provider type that determines the API format

api_key.description: API key for authentication with the provider

oauth.description: OAuth2 token for authentication with the provider

system_prompt_prefix.description: Custom prefix to add to system prompts for this provider

extra_headers.description: Additional HTTP headers to send with requests

extra_body.description: Additional fields to include in request bodies, only works with openai-compatible providers

provider_options.description: Additional provider-specific options for this provider

models.description: List of models available from this provider

model.description: The model ID as used by the provider API

provider.description: The model provider ID that matches a key in the providers config

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort level for OpenAI models that support it

think.description: Enable thinking mode for Anthropic models that support reasoning

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens for model responses

presence_penalty.description: Presence penalty to increase topic diversity

provider_options.description: Additional provider-specific options for the model

compact_mode.description: Enable compact mode for the TUI interface

diff_mode.description: Diff mode for the TUI interface

transparent.description: Enable transparent background for the TUI interface

max_reminders.description: Maximum number of follow-up reminders to send while todos remain incomplete. Raise it to keep re-prompting until all tasks are closed.

target_completion.description: Stop sending reminders once this fraction (0-1) of todos are completed. Defaults to 1.0 (all tasks).

timeout.description: Timeout for the grep tool call

max_depth.description: Maximum depth for the ls tool

max_items.description: Maximum number of items to return for the ls tool
